rows.name: Intimidating Shout
rows.d: A roar that sends every foe within 3 squares running for 4 rounds.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.d: The whole party locks shields: armor +5 for 8 rounds.

rows.name: Hamstring
rows.d: A low cut to the legs: it slows the foe and leaves it bleeding. About 286 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 95 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Battle Standard
rows.d: A raised banner: the party deals 25% more damage and hits 10% more often for 10 rounds.

rows.name: Warlord's Challenge
rows.d: Every foe within 4 squares turns on its neighbours, and takes more damage while it does.

rows.name: Savage Roar
rows.d: A bestial roar: foes within 3 squares flee and fight weaker.

rows.name: Rend
rows.d: Claws tear the foe ahead and leave it bleeding. About 222 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 120 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Blood Frenzy
rows.d: Red rage: +60% damage and +15% double hits for 6 rounds.

rows.name: Earthshatter
rows.d: A fist into the ground: foes within 3 squares are thrown down for 2 rounds. About 131 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Avatar of the Bear
rows.d: The bear spirit takes you: double damage, fast healing and +4 armor for 8 rounds.

rows.name: Lay on Hands
rows.d: Heals the most wounded ally for 40-60 and cleanses their afflictions. It heals at least that, and more as you grow: about 37 percent of the health of whoever it heals.

rows.name: Holy Chains
rows.d: Golden chains hold the foe ahead for 4 rounds and burn it. About 256 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Aura of Courage
rows.d: The party fights bolder for 12 rounds: +15% damage, +10% to hit and enemies miss more.

rows.name: Smite Evil
rows.d: Holy fire on foes within 3 squares, doubled against skeletons, and it curses them. About 120 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Avenging Angel
rows.d: An angel at your side: the party heals for 30-40 and deals 40% more damage for 8 rounds. It heals at least that, and more as you grow: about 42 percent of the health of whoever it heals.

rows.name: Entangling Roots
rows.d: Roots burst from the ground and hold every foe within 3 squares for 3 rounds.

rows.name: Bark Skin
rows.d: The skin of the whole party toughens like bark: armor +6 for 10 rounds.

rows.name: Poison Arrow
rows.d: A poisoned shot: damage, then poison every round. About 246 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 106 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Swarm of Wasps
rows.d: Wasps cover every foe within 3 squares: stung, poisoned and blinded. About 138 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Wrath of the Forest
rows.d: The forest rises: foes within 4 squares take damage, are rooted and lash out at each other. About 180 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Flaming Arrow
rows.d: An arrow wrapped in fire: damage, then burning every round. About 190 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 102 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Pinning Shot
rows.d: An arrow through the foot: damage, and the foe is pinned for 3 rounds. About 451 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Rain of Arrows
rows.d: A hundred arrows fall on every foe within 4 squares. About 161 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Cursed Arrow
rows.d: A black arrow: damage and bleeding, and the foe hits weaker for 8 rounds. About 384 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 207 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Dragonbone Arrow
rows.d: One arrow of dragon bone. A foe under a quarter health simply dies. About 656 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Pickpocket
rows.d: Lift gold from the foe ahead. You get more at higher levels.

rows.name: Smoke Bomb
rows.d: Thick smoke blinds every foe within 3 squares for 5 rounds: they miss much more often.

rows.name: Venom Blade
rows.d: A poisoned stab that also slows the foe. About 221 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 119 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Befuddle
rows.d: Foes within 4 squares see enemies everywhere and fight each other for 4 rounds.

rows.name: Master Heist
rows.d: Rob every foe within 4 squares blind and leave them frozen with surprise for 2 rounds.

rows.name: Garrote
rows.d: A wire round the throat: damage, then bleeding every round. About 134 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 134 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Marked for Death
rows.d: The foe takes 50% more damage from every blow for 8 rounds and hits weaker.

rows.name: Night Terror
rows.d: Nightmares walk among the foes within 4 squares: they flee for 5 rounds.

rows.name: Poison Cloud
rows.d: A cloud of green death over every foe within 3 squares. About 64 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 95 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Death Warrant
rows.d: A foe under 40% health dies at once. About 389 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Hold Person
rows.d: The foe ahead cannot move or act for 5 rounds.

rows.name: Polymorph: Sheep
rows.d: The foe becomes a harmless sheep for 8 rounds. Baa.

rows.name: Mirror Images
rows.d: Ghostly copies of the party draw blows: enemies miss 25% more for 8 rounds.

rows.name: Disintegrate
rows.d: A beam of unmaking. A foe under 20% health is dust. About 285 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Time Stop
rows.d: Time stops for every foe in sight for 3 rounds. The party moves freely.

rows.name: Arcane Lance
rows.d: A lance of pure force. The foe takes more from the next blows. About 223 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Wail of Fear
rows.d: A wail that turns the courage of every foe within 4 squares to water.

rows.name: Polymorph: Cow
rows.d: The foe becomes a placid cow for 8 rounds. Moo.

rows.name: Wild Surge
rows.d: Raw chaos: a random mighty effect. Damage, a sheep, a heal, a hold. Anything can happen.

rows.name: Dragon's Breath
rows.d: A cone of fire: foes within 3 squares take damage and burn for 5 rounds. About 80 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 34 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Rift of Banishing
rows.d: Opens a rift that swallows the foe ahead. Great beasts and bosses take a heavy blow instead.

rows.name: Chain Lightning
rows.d: Lightning leaps between every foe within 3 squares. About 80 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Purify
rows.d: Cleanses every affliction on the party and restores about 8 health to everyone.

rows.name: Turn Undead
rows.d: Undead within 4 squares flee for 10 rounds or are destroyed. Living foes cower for 2 rounds.

rows.name: Sanctuary Ward
rows.d: A sacred ward: armor +4 and enemies miss 15% more for 10 rounds.

rows.name: Divine Wrath
rows.d: Light from the heavens strikes every foe within 4 squares, and curses them. About 105 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.d: Raises every fallen hero at 70% health and heals the living for half.

rows.name: Restoration
rows.d: Restores about 561 health to the most wounded ally. The strongest single heal, and it costs a great deal of mana.

rows.name: Smiting Light
rows.d: Hallowed light on every foe within 3 squares, and it curses them. About 80 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Pressure Point
rows.d: A finger on the right spot: the foe ahead cannot move for 4 rounds.

rows.name: Wholeness of Body
rows.d: You heal 50-70 and cleanse every affliction on you. It heals at least that, and more as you grow: about 46 percent of the health of whoever it heals.

rows.name: Quivering Palm
rows.d: A strike that keeps hurting: damage, bleeding and a weakened foe. About 282 damage for Sigrid at level 1. Plus about 121 more over the following rounds.

rows.name: Mantra of Peace
rows.d: Foes within 4 squares fall asleep until they are hurt, or 5 rounds pass.

rows.name: Thousand Fists
rows.d: Five rapid blows land on every foe within 3 squares. About 206 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Bleat of Doom
rows.d: A bleat so awful that every foe within 4 squares runs for 4 rounds.

rows.name: Eat Anything
rows.d: The goat eats everything, then the party feels better: cleansed, fed and healed. It heals at least that, and more as you grow: about 24 percent of the health of whoever it heals.

rows.name: Polymorph: Goat
rows.d: The foe becomes a goat for 10 rounds. It seems pleased.

rows.name: Mountain Charge
rows.d: A charge from the high peaks: a stunned foe. About 394 damage for Sigrid at level 1.

rows.name: Great Stampede
rows.d: A spectral herd thunders through every foe within 5 squares. About 201 damage to each foe in reach for Sigrid at level 1.
